programme.title: Insecure 3
programme.desc: The further fate of Issa Dee (Issa Rae), a young African-American woman living in Los Angeles.The girl, despite numerous humiliations and lack of self-confidence, tries to live her own way.Her best friend is self-absorbed lawyer Molly (Yvonne Orji).However, their relationship is going through a crisis.Issa tries to overcome her weaknesses with varying degrees of success.He begins to question his role in the non-governmental organization where he works.He earns money as a driver.She's also trying to pick up the pieces after her breakup with Lawrence.Trying to save extra money, she stays with her former partner and childhood friend, Daniel, who is working on developing his musical career.Meanwhile, Molly starts a new job.She is surprised that she is not immediately considered a star in the new law firm.This affects her self-confidence.The third season of a brilliant comedy series about the life of an insecure young African-American woman.The production tells the story of a generation of twenty-somethings lost in the world of today, their friendships, experiences, joys and problems.The originator of the series, its producer and the main actress is the talented Issa Rae (series "First").She gained fame through her website The Misadventures Of Awkward Black Girl and her YouTube channel (over 200,000 followers and 20 million views).The other characters are played by, among others:Yvonne Orji (series "Love That Girl!") and Lisa Joyce ("It's Never Too Late").The production was nominated for a Golden Globe.

programme.title: Gone Girl
programme.desc: On the day of his fifth wedding anniversary with Amy (Rosamund Pike), Nick Dunne (Ben Affleck) reports to the police that his wife has disappeared in mysterious circumstances.The case of her disappearance quickly reaches the media.Detective Rhonda Boney (Kim Dickens) leading the investigation discovers numerous inconsistencies in the man's testimony.There are speculations that Nick may have had something to do with Amy's mysterious disappearance.Supported by his twin sister, Margo (Carrie Coon), the man desperately tries to prove his innocence.Over time, new facts come to light which show that the Dunnes' marriage was a toxic relationship.The film by the creator of the cult thriller "Seven", David Fincher, was nominated, among others,to the Golden Globe.For her role as Amy, Rosamund Pike received nominations for an Oscar, a Golden Globe and other awards.The film's script, also nominated for a Golden Globe, was based on the best-selling novel by Gillian Flynn.

programme.title: The Last Duel
programme.desc: France, 14th century.Marquerite de Carrouges (Jodie Comer) accuses Jacques le Gris (Adam Driver) of rape.The man was once friends with her husband, Jean (Matt Damon), from a respectable family.They shed blood together in battles, but later their paths diverged.They were divided by a fight for money and influence.Favored by Count Pierre d'Alencon (Ben Affleck), the less connected, but ambitious and educated Jacques won further honors.However, it was Jean who married a beautiful, proud and intelligent woman who also caught the attention of his companion.Now the knight must defend her and his honor.He challenges le Gris, who denies the allegations, to a duel.Not only pride and justice are at stake - if de Carrouges dies, his wife will also die.The spectacular story with stylish photos by Dariusz Wolski is based on facts.The last court duel took place in France in 1386.

programme.desc: Animal tamer OJ Haywood (Daniel Kaluuya) and his sister Emerald (Keke Palmer) live on a ranch in southern California where horses are trained for Hollywood film productions.They take over the business of their father, who died in suspicious circumstances.Problems are piling up for them.One day they become witnesses of inexplicable phenomena.Together with a former child star (Steven Yeun), an emcee at a family amusement park, they try to film supernatural incidents to make money by selling sensational materials.Their actions have unforeseen consequences.Director Jordan Peele made his debut in 2017 with the acclaimed thriller "Get Out!", for which he won an Oscar for the script.

programme.title: Green Book
programme.desc: USA, 1960s. Tony Vallelonga, a simple resident of the Bronx who has a wife and a group of children to support, agrees to accompany, as a chauffeur and bodyguard, a black musician - the luxurious erudite Donald Shirley - on a concert tour across the United States.Not only does he have to defend his protégé from troubles in the Deep South, but he also has to combat prejudiced views.During their journey, they both follow the instructions from the "Green Book" guide for African Americans traveling around the country.It includes, among others:suggestions on where to sleep and eat to avoid unpleasant incidents.The time spent together and overcoming mounting problems cause a surprising, lasting bond to emerge between men from different worlds.

programme.title: The Hobbit: The Desolation of Smaug
programme.desc: The hobbit Bilbo (Martin Freeman), Gandalf (Ian McKellen) and the dwarves led by Thorin (Richard Armitage) continue their dangerous journey.The goal of their expedition is to regain Erebor - the kingdom of the dwarves, which is currently occupied by the dragon Smaug (Benedict Cumberbatch).The travelers meet the bear warrior Beorn (Mikael Persbrandt), giant spiders inhabiting Mirkwood, the Wood Elves and their master, King Thranduil (Lee Pace), his son Legolas (Orlando Bloom), and the elf Tauriel (Evangeline Lilly).Thanks to an archer called Bard (Luke Evans), they get to Lake Town.When they reach the Lonely Mountain, they will come face to face with their greatest danger.The second part of the trilogy based on the novel by J.R.R.Tolkien.The film starred, among others: Ian McKellen ("Gods and Monsters"), Martin Freeman ("Fargo", "Sherlock") and Richard Armitage ("Versa", "Epicenter").The film, made on a grand scale, received three Oscar nominations, including for best special effects.

programme.title: L'amica geniale 2
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-olds Lila (Gaia Girace) and Elena (Margherita Mazzucco) are bored with the monotony of everyday life.Lila has just gotten married, but the wedding has made her feel like she's lost herself.Elena is doing great at school, but her friend's wedding helped her understand something.She discovered that she didn't feel happy among her friends.The girls spend their holidays in Ischia.Once there, they run into their old friend from the neighborhood, Nino Sarratore (Francesco Serpico).The man is studying and it seems that a great future awaits him.Unexpectedly, this meeting has a negative impact on Lila and Elena's friendship.Their relationship is loosening.One day, Lila comes up with an idea and opens an exclusive shoe salon in Naples.The store belongs to the Solar family.Meanwhile, Elena is committed to her studies.She manages to get into the University of Pisa.Adaptation of the second part of the novel series by Elena Ferrante.

programme.title: The Glassworker
programme.desc: Vincent Oliver, the son of renowned glassmaker Tomasz, is preparing for his first exhibition when he finds a letter from his childhood friend, Alliz Amano, whom he has always loved.He recalls how - raised by a pacifist father - he saw her for the first time.Alliz arrives in Vincent's city, Waterfront, with her parent, Colonel Amano.They become a couple.Meanwhile, a war breaks out and both he and his rival for the girl's favor, Malik, join the army.Tomasz is forced to produce glass rectifiers for the army.Some time later, the girl's father dies without any news at the front.When Malik returns to town with him, Alliz rewards him with a kiss, which Vincent witnesses.Devastated, he sabotages the production of rectifiers, but this leads to tragedy.The anime-inspired production with an anti-war message is the first Pakistani film made using the hand-animated technique.

programme.title: The Munsters
programme.desc: Transylvania.Dr. Henry Augustus Wolfgang (Richard Brake) and his not very bright assistant Floop (Jorge Garcia) want to create the perfect man from the dead bodies of geniuses of the past century.By mistake, instead of the brain of a great scientist, they implant the organ of his twin brother, a bad comedian, into the creature they created.This is how Herman Potwornicki (Jeff Daniel Phillips) is created.When Wolfgang decides to show it to the world on TV, he is devastated.However, the uncouth, joking giant attracts the attention of the unmarried and undead Lily (Sheri Moon), who is fed up with unsuccessful dates.The girl finds Herman and they quickly become a couple.The future son-in-law, although he gained fame and won Lily's heart, does not like her father, a vampire and a refined count (Daniel Roebuck).However, the lovers get married.Due to the intrigues of the count's cunning ex-wife, Zoya Krupp (Catherine Schell) and her assistant, the werewolf Lester (Tomas Boykin), they lose their palace and fortune.They decide to go to America, where Herman intends to conquer Hollywood.They start a new life in a ruined house in the suburbs.A colorful production referring to the series from the 1960s. Director Rob Zombie is his big fan.

programme.title: Noah: Chosen by God
programme.desc: The distant past.Due to the wickedness of Cain's descendants, the inhabitants of large cities, the world is falling into decline.Only representatives of the House of Set still carry out the will of the Creator.One night, former warrior and healer Noah (Russell Crowe) has a terrible dream.He sees it as a gigantic flood that destroys the world.Along with his wife Naameh (Jennifer Connelly) and three sons, he visits his grandfather Methuselah (Anthony Hopkins) to seek his advice.He discovers that his dream is actually a prediction of the great flood.Noah becomes aware that he has been chosen by the Creator to save the lives of innocents.With the help of stone giants called Guardians, he begins work on an ark that will be a shelter for various animal species.Years later, when the specter of disaster becomes more and more real, the huge ship is almost ready.Then the descendant of the first murderer, the self-proclaimed ruler Tubal-kain (Ray Winstone), demands a place in the ark for himself and his subjects.
